holes_addressed.hole: C5-1 moderate: "SAME code" false at the testable gate
holes_addressed.resolution: C5-1 (moderate): rev5 said our B1-M-001 band was scored with "the SAME code and words" as the card. It was not: the card branch required 3-sigma injection power >= 0.8 at the claimed value in every admitted variant and allowed a +2 SD consistency margin; our branch had neither. Fixed with option (i): one function, dr1_label() in rev6_dr1_unified.py, scores both, with the power gate (card at -17.8 nT; our band at its most testable point, -25 nT) and the same +2 SD margin. Effect, all on our side: our band is now UNTESTED at ESK and LER (ESK power at -25 nT 0.56-0.84 (7 of 8 variants below 0.8); LER power at -25 nT 0.32-0.76 (8 of 8 variants below 0.8)), so SC-26 is retracted and rev4 was right there (SC-27). At EBR, SPT, HAD, CLF, NGK the falsified portion is reported from the 0.8-power amplitude a80 rather than the 3-sigma threshold: EBR [-25, -18.75] nT (power at -25 nT 0.95-1.00), SPT [-25, -16.5] nT (power at -25 nT 1.00-1.00), HAD [-25, -20.75] nT (power at -25 nT 0.92-1.00), CLF [-25, -18.25] nT (power at -25 nT 0.95-1.00), NGK [-25, -24.25] nT (power at -25 nT 0.84-1.00). No dome label changes: card power is 1.00 in every admitted cell (sensitivity tau 30: 0.95-1.00). Option (ii) (drop the gate) was considered and not taken: the c5 review recommended (i), and (i) is the version whose rule text was already published in rev5. Under (ii) SC-26 would have stood (ESK/LER sliver "absent"); we report that here so the choice is visible.

kernel_of_truth: Three real things sit under the dome's eclipse claims. Eclipses do disturb ground magnetometers, and on 2026-08-12 the raw H at the dome's stations really was 13-19 nT low. The dome's quiet-day precondition is good practice; its Boulder statistic is well defined and exactly reproducible, and this day failed it. And across the dome's stations the eclipse-window Z residuals do increase northward in its FSF order, more than on any of 19 ordinary days. A fourth point: the PRED-095 card's own falsifier did not fire, and San Pablo's +/-60 min peak sits inside the band of the card's own formula value (as it does on 3 of 25 ordinary days). None of that saves the claims: ordinary days produce the same raw H and meet both of the card's bands; the card's -17.8 nT was testable and absent at the lags its own "during totality" admits; the dome's named Z component shows the latitude ordering at about half the formula's -10.9-baseline size and far below its x1.672 size; the contact-phase signature it calls ECM-unique is absent where it would have stood out; and a sunset eclipse under standard physics can also produce larger effects where the Sun stood higher - in the north - though we have not shown that it does here. Being right about the ordering does not favour dome physics. A void test is not a confirmation, and the dome's own live scoreboard still reads PENDING.

anticipated_objections.objection: "Calling your own band UNTESTED at ESK and LER is convenient - you just removed two falsifications of your own range."
anticipated_objections.response: The power gate is the one rule text rev5 already published, and the card has been held to it since rev5. Applying it to us too is what symmetry requires; it does not touch any dome label. Both readings are on the record: under option (ii) (no gate anywhere) the ESK/LER sliver is "absent" and the card label is the same. Either way our band was met on 17 of 30 ordinary days under its own metric - non-diagnostic, our design error.

anticipated_objections.objection: "The +2 SD consistency margin now helps your band."
anticipated_objections.response: It is the card's margin, now applied to both. It changes nothing on this day: no CTL-1-surviving detection exists at any station or lag for either registration.

anticipated_objections.objection: Dome defender: "San Pablo read -15.6 nT, inside the formula band - the dome was right."
anticipated_objections.response: R2 is the largest deviation within +/-60 min, not a during-totality reading, and not the quantity DR-1 scores. 3 of 25 ordinary San Pablo days fall in the same band, so the reading does not discriminate. The card's stated band (-19.8 to -15.8) is still missed, and at the lags "during totality" admits the joint fits are 4.1-7.7 SD from -17.8 with power 1.00. We disclose it because the symmetry obligation requires it, not because it changes the label.

anticipated_objections.objection: "A results file that keeps changing labels after the data were seen is not credible."
anticipated_objections.response: Every change in rev6 corrects our side or adds a dome-favourable disclosure; no dome label moves. Each rule carries preregistered:false, and the definitive-data re-run rule is now mechanical and dated before definitive data exist.
